description: A possible 5th/6th CE wooden church. Tentatively the earliest archaeologically dated church in Ireland.
bibliography: O’Sullivan, Aidan. Early Medieval Dwellings and Settlements in Ireland, AD 400-1100. BAR International Series 2604. Oxford, England: Archaeopress, 2014.

Sheehan, J. “A Peacock’s Tale: Excavations at Caherlehillan, Iveragh, Ireland.” In The Archaeology of the Early Medieval Celtic Churches: Proceedings of a Conference on the Archaeology of the Early Medieval Celtic Churches, September 2004. 191 - 206, 2009. https://codecs.vanhamel.nl/Sheehan_(John)_2009_bprpfvj.
